# Donations site: compliance and scope

| Ref | Obligation |
|---|---|
| C1 | Donors must be able to stop recurring gifts at any time, under the Fundraising Code. |
| C2 | Donations from corporate accounts above 10,000 must be reported to the board, per the Governance Policy. |
| C3 | Gift Aid declarations must be kept for six years under the Charity Tax Rules. |

## Backlog

US-1 As a supporter, I want to see the campaign total so that I know how close it is.
US-2 As a supporter, I want to set up a birthday fundraiser so that friends give instead of gifts.
US-3 As a donor, I want to donate in memory of someone so that their name is honoured.
US-4 As a donor, I want to give once by card so that I can support a cause quickly.
US-5 As a donor, I want to change the amount of my monthly gift so that I can give what I can afford.
US-6 As a donor, I want a thank-you message after I give so that I know it worked.
US-7 As a donor, I want to download a donation receipt so that I can keep it.
US-8 As a supporter, I want to share a campaign on social media so that friends see it.

Donations from corporate accounts above 10,000 must be reported to the board, per the Governance Policy.
Gift Aid declarations must be kept for six years under the Charity Tax Rules.
